AGENDA
  CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION
  Council Chambers, City Hall – 613 E. Broadway, 2nd Floor
  Glendale, CA 91206

Welcome to the meeting of the Civil Service Commission. Meetings are broadcast live on cable channel 6 (GTV6) and rebroadcast throughout the
week. Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. DVDs and Videotapes of the proceedings are available for purchase in the City Clerk’s Office by
  calling (818) 548-2090. Please turn off cellular phones and pagers while inside the Council Chambers.

 In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign language translation, and Braille transcripts are
available upon request. Assisted listening devices are available same-day upon request. At least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required
  for requests regarding sign language translation and Braille transcription services.

All documents related to open session items on this agenda that are received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and are public records, will
  be available for review in the Human Resources office, 613 E. Broadway, Room 100, Glendale, CA 91206.

  If you have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for assistance, please contact Human Resources at (818) 548-2110 during
  regular business hours.

minutes_text:
CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION
  MINUTES
  January 9, 2019
  City Council Chambers

1.  ROLL CALL
  Chair Abkarian called the meeting to order at 5:02 pm.

  Present: Manoukian, Ghazarian, MacCarley, Devine, Chair Abkarian.

  Items were taken out of order with the sequence being as follows : Item 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8, 9, 10, §, 11, 12, 13.

2.  MINUTES
  Action: Consideration of the Minutes for the meeting of December 12, 2018.

  Motion: Manoukian  Second: MacCarley
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous

3.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to items NOT a part of the agenda. Each speaker is limited to f ive minutes. Commission
  may question the speaker, but there will be no debate or decision.

  Ignacio Saavedra addressed the Commission .

4.  RECRUITMENT AND EXAMINATION REPORT
  Mr. Doyle reviewed the Recruitment and Examination Report.

5.  ELIGIBLE LISTS ESTABLISHED
  Mr. Doyle reviewed the Eligible Lists established.

7.  CLASS SPECIFICATION FOR APPROVAL-LIBRARIAN SERIES (NAVARRO)
  Action: Approval of class specification for Librarian Series as submitted.

  The class specification for Librarian Series was approved as submitted by the following vote:

  Motion: Devine  Second: Manoukian
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous

8.  JOB BULLETIN FOR APPROVAL- BUILDING REPAIRER (VARDANYAN)
  Action: Approval of job bulletin for Building Repairer as submitted.

  The job bulletin for Building Repairer was approved as submitted by the following vote:

  Motion: MacCarley  Second: Manoukian
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous

9.  PUBLIC HEARING-AMENDMENTS TO CIVIL SERVICE RULES & REGULATIONS (DOYLE)
  Action : This item is presented for discussion and appropriate action.

  Mr. Doyle and the members of the Civil Service Commission reviewed the proposed amendments to the Civil
  Services Rules and Regulations and the recommendations provided by the Glendale employee unions. The
  discussion resulted in the following votes:

  1. Amendment to Rule Ill, Section 8-E (Page 12) - Medical Disqualification/Reimbursement to Applicant
  Approved by the Commission by a 5-0 vote.
  3
   Civil Service Commission Minutes of January 9, 2019
  Page 2 of3

  2. Amendment to Rule 111, Section 10 (Page 12) - Applications Procedure
  Approved by the Commission by a 5-0 vote.

  3. Amendment to Rule IV, Section 10 (Page 15) - Oral Board Examination
  Approved by the Commission by a 5-0 vote.

  4. Amendment to Rule V, Section 7 (Page 22) - Repeal of Certification
  Approved by the Commission by a 5-0 vote.

  5. Amendment to Rule V, Section 9 (Page 23)-Temporary Appointments
  The Commission rejected the proposed alteration by the employee unions and voted to approve the
  amendment in its original form in a 5-0 vote.

  6. Amendment to Rule VI, Section 2-F (Page 25)- Probationary Period Extensions
  Approved by the Commission by a 5-0 vote.

  7. Amendment to Rule VII, Section 2 (Page 27) - Job Performance Evaluations - Reporting Periods
  Approved by the Commission by a 5-0 vote.

  8. Amendment to Rule X, Section 3 (Page 33)- Placement on Administrative Leave
  Approved by the Commission by a 5-0 vote.

  9. Amendment to Rule X, Section 3-A (Page 33) -Administrative Leave
  Approved by the Commission by a S·O vote.

  10. Amendment to Rule X, Section 6 (Page 36) - Disciplinary Appeals
  Approved by the Commission by a 5-0 vote.

  11. Amendment to Rule X, Section 8, C-4 (c-i) (Page 38) - Hearing Procedure
  Approved by the Commission by a 5-0 vote.

  12. Amendment to Rule X, New Section 10 (Page 39) - Disciplinary Appeals and Hearing Procedures
  Approved by the Commission by a 5-0 vote.

  13. Amendment to Rule XI, Section 2-F (Page 42) - Transfer In-Lieu of Layoff
  Approved by the Commission by a 5-0 vote.

10.  REPORTS- INFORMATION
  a) Past Due Employee Performance Evaluations.

  Mr. Doyle reviewed the Past Due Employee Performance Evaluations Report.

6.  REORGANIZATION OF THE COMMISSION
  Action: Select new Commission Chair and Vice-Chair.

  Commissioner Devine nominated Commissioner MacCarley for Commission Chair.
  Vote: Ayes: Unanimous
  Chair MacCarley accepted the nomination

  Commissioner Devine nominated Commissioner Ghazarian for Commission Vice-Chair.
  4
  Vote : Ayes: Unanimous
   Civil Service Commission Minutes of January 9, 2019
  Page 3 of 3

  Vice. chair Ghazarian accepted the nomination

11,  CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION/STAFF COMMENTS
  Commissioner Devine asked staff to generate a report that clarifies an employee's ability to appeal an issue
  to the Civil Service Commission. Commissioner MacCarley noted a possibility of utilizing an independent
  investigator for employee complaints and requested that this issue be placed on the agenda so that a robust
  discussion may occur. Commissioner Ghazarian asked for clarification regrading what constitutes sufficient
  basis for an employee to appeal to the Civil Service Commission. Chair Abkarian requested that this issue be
  brought back during the April meeting.

12.  CLOSED SESSION
  a) Public Employee Discipline: Police Officer

13.  ADJOURNMENT
  Action: Move to adjourn.

  There being no further business to come before the Commission, the meeting was adjourned at 5:59 pm.

  We, the members of the Civil Service Commission of the City of Glendale, certify that the foregoing Minutes
  are a true and correct record of our proceedings.of January 9, 2019.

  5
   RESOLUTION OF THE CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION
  OF THE CITY OF GLENDALE

  UNCLASSIFIED TEMPORARY POSITION

  BE IT RESOLVED BY THE CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF
GLENDALE, CALIFORNIA:

  That, pursuant to City Charter, Article XXIV, Section 7, and Rule II of the Civil
Service Rules and Regulations of the Civil Service Commission of the City of Glendale declare
the following:

  That one {1) budgeted salaried position of Homeless Programs Coordinator be hereby
declared unclassified and exempt from the classified service.

  Passed by the Civil Service Commission of the City of Glendale on the 13th day of
February, 2019.
